title: Safavid campaign (1554–1555)
text: The Safavid campaign of 1554–1555 was the final bout of hostilities between the Ottomans and the Safavids during the Ottoman-Safavid War of 1532–1555. It was launched by Suleiman the Magnificent, and took place between June 1554 and May 1555. It was part of the wider conflict between the Sunni and Shia Muslims.
